ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels vs 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized primarily at the trailing margins and central longitudinal axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark border (approx. 5-15 pixels wide) along the trailing edge; dark vertical striation at the central notch extending inferiorly; sparse black focal spots on the right lobe medial region; dense linear dark-grey scratching across the white ventral expanse of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 60-70 degrees; depth is roughly 1/6th of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; amplitude of peaks varies between 3-12 pixels; highest amplitude irregularities and jaggedness observed on the distal half of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from notch to distal tips along the trailing edge; significant geometric noise on the outer tips due to biological encrustation protruding beyond the smooth fluke boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of white/grey pixel formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several dark circular mottling points (0.5% area) on the right lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the ventral surface; predominant orientations are vertical and diagonal; high density observed on the lower left lobe and mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on both distal tips; significant parallel scarring (rake marks) covering a large portion of the visible white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced protrusion of acorn barnacles at the furthest lateral points, altering the expected smooth geometric curvature of the tips.
